bug_semantics: Velociraptor's server-side VQL query() plugin (vql/tools/query.go QueryPlugin.Call) accepts org_id to evaluate a subquery in another org. The plugin builds the subquery scope with ScopeBuilderFromScope(scope), which copies the caller's ACLManager (the current org's ACL token), then on org_id only replaces builder.Config with org_manager.GetOrgConfig(arg.OrgId). It does not construct a target-org ACL manager. An authenticated GUI user who can run a notebook cell in org A can therefore call query(query=..., org_id=<B>) and run VQL against org B's clients, hunts, and filestore using the same permissions they hold in A, even if they have no membership in B (CWE-863). runas impersonation did create NewServerACLManager for the target org, but the org-only path did not, so a notebook user did not need IMPERSONATION to cross orgs.
flaw_origin: The org-switch without ACL rebind was first written in PR #1949 member 416a2e9d7e076b49aa532db6bbb257ecccf596d3 (2022-07-20, Mike Cohen). That commit added QueryPluginArgs.OrgId and the block that sets builder.Config = org_config_obj while leaving the inherited ACLManager in place, explicitly to let query() run hunts and retrieve results across orgs. GitHub squash-merged the PR as 63e99f45975f9bf237b1afc3490e10aa365caaa0 onto master; the squash is a carrier, not the first-write. Immediate parent 28dd0366ec194e798210eaa2b9c527cec2143084 has query() with no OrgId field and no builder.Config assignment. The same org-only path (Config switch, ACL token reused) is still present at v0.76.2 and v0.75.7.

Vulnerable sink: vql/tools/query.go QueryPlugin.Call. At BIC 416a2e9d7e076b49aa532db6bbb257ecccf596d3 lines 23, 69-82: OrgId field; builder := services.ScopeBuilderFromScope(scope); if arg.OrgId != "" { org_config_obj, err = org_manager.GetOrgConfig(arg.OrgId); builder.Config = org_config_obj } with no ACLManager assignment. runas (lines 84-95) is the only path that called NewServerACLManager.
ScopeBuilderFromScope (services/repository.go at v0.76.2) copies artifacts.GetACLManager(scope) into builder.ACLManager, so the org-only path reuses the notebook org token after switching Config.

NewServerACLManager(org_config_obj, principal) loads the principal's ACL token for that org's config, so a user with no grants in the target org no longer inherits the notebook org token. Later #4947/ed6f5e7c (CVE-class impersonation check in the target org) is a distinct 0.77 issue, not CVE-2026-6290.
reasoning: CVE-2026-6290 is a real Rapid7 CNA record (not withdrawn). The mechanism is query() org_id switching the VQL config into another org while keeping the caller's ACL token from ScopeBuilderFromScope. The smallest first-write of that mechanism is PR #1949 member 416a2e9d7e076b49aa532db6bbb257ecccf596d3: it added OrgId and builder.Config = GetOrgConfig(arg.OrgId) without resetting ACLManager. Parent 28dd0366ec194e798210eaa2b9c527cec2143084 was checked directly and lacks OrgId and builder.Config. The GitHub squash 63e99f45 is the on-master carrier (identical query.go to 416a2e9d) and is in the affected tags (v0.6.6-rc1 onward through v0.76.2 / v0.75.7). The complete fix rebinds builder.ACLManager to NewServerACLManager(target org, GetPrincipal(scope)). That two-line change first appeared on master in 8c9bf842ea8a5f7b25c73bfe8a5e390524239ab5 (recorded as direct_fix_sha) and was released as 0.76.3 in 1c6f3b700d6723566c6538ad8d00e0824e3d54a6 (fix_sha, VERSION bump plus the same rebind; ancestor of v0.76.4, not of v0.76.2) and as 0.75.8 in cac40fc35af5f8e8742a0b45219f139f53a731a5.
